source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill declares external API and version lookup as not applicable.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires the explicit local-only non-applicability declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only Skill declaration

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local-only Skill validates without Context7, MCP connections, or network access.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing obligations do not require these external facilities to be absent during local-only validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: A local fixture without network configuration passes validation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation supplies this local-only positive verification case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only fixture verification

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a Skill falsely declares itself local-only while declaring a network or API dependency.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation covers this contradictory-declaration failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Local-only declaration consistency

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares Context7-first lookup when available.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires Context7-first lookup ordering for version-sensitive Skills.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive lookup policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares an official HTTPS fallback when Context7 is unavailable.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this specific fallback policy.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive fallback

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill records version, source, and retrieval date.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing dependency/version obligations do not require this complete provenance record for version-sensitive lookups.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version and source provenance

source_gap_claims.behavior: A version-sensitive Skill declares behavior for missing or stale information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires a missing or stale-information policy for version-sensitive Skills.
source_gap_claims.subject: Stale-information handling

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a version-sensitive declaration omits version, source, or retrieval date.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation covers these specific provenance omissions.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version-sensitive declaration validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails for an HTTP fallback.
source_gap_claims.reason: The network obligations do not specifically prohibit HTTP downgrade for version-sensitive fallback declarations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Fallback transport validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails for an arbitrary nonofficial fallback origin.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires fallback origins to be official for this version-sensitive lookup case.
source_gap_claims.subject: Fallback origin validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a version-sensitive declaration lacks a failure policy for unavailable or stale information.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires this failure-policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Version lookup failure policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Historical version records are treated as syntax and provenance inputs rather than proof of the current latest version.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation limits the evidentiary meaning of historical version records in this way.
source_gap_claims.subject: Historical version records

source_gap_claims.behavior: Static validation performs no Context7 or other version lookup.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation explicitly forbids live version lookup during static validation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Static validation execution boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities name their runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires a credential-owner declaration for secret-using capabilities.
source_gap_claims.subject: Credential ownership

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare a safe credential reference mechanism.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires a safe secret-reference mechanism declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Credential reference mechanism

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare a redaction policy.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires a capability-specific redaction policy.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret redaction

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-using capabilities declare denied output locations.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires explicit denied output locations for secret-bearing capabilities.
source_gap_claims.subject: Denied secret-output locations

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails for synthetic literal credential fields or known secret markers.
source_gap_claims.reason: Generic secret-free output obligations do not require these declaration fixtures to be rejected.
source_gap_claims.subject: Synthetic credential fixture validation

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a secret-using capability omits its runtime credential owner.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation covers a missing credential-owner failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing credential owner

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a secret-using capability permits raw secret output.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation specifically rejects a raw secret-output policy declaration.
source_gap_claims.subject: Raw secret-output policy

source_gap_claims.behavior: Secret-related diagnostics report location and rule without exposing credential values.
source_gap_claims.reason: Existing generic diagnostic constraints do not fully require the secret-capability reporting restriction.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret diagnostic reporting

source_gap_claims.behavior: Verification uses no real credential fixture.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation prohibits real credential material in secret-capability verification fixtures.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret fixture safety

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard makes no universal claim that the validator detects every secret.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation constrains the validator's secret-detection claim in this manner.
source_gap_claims.subject: Secret-detection claim boundary

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare their affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires affected-scope declarations for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations declare the required confirmation or authorization source.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires an authorization-source declaration for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation authorization

source_gap_claims.behavior: Destructive operations disclose recovery options or irreversibility.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation requires recovery or irreversibility disclosure for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation recovery disclosure

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a destructive operation omits affected scope.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation covers this destructive-operation boundary failure.
source_gap_claims.subject: Missing destructive-operation scope

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when a destructive operation includes a bypass flag.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation rejects bypass flags on destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation bypass prevention

source_gap_claims.behavior: Validation fails when destructive-operation confirmation is derived solely from untrusted input.
source_gap_claims.reason: Although untrusted content is constrained generally, no obligation applies that rule specifically to destructive-operation confirmation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Destructive-operation confirmation integrity

source_gap_claims.behavior: Existing session or user authorization is accepted when the owning policy permits it.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation preserves this specific authorization source as sufficient for destructive operations.
source_gap_claims.subject: Existing authorization acceptance

source_gap_claims.behavior: The standard does not add a redundant confirmation requirement to every destructive operation.
source_gap_claims.reason: No obligation constrains confirmation policy to avoid redundant confirmation for every operation.
source_gap_claims.subject: Confirmation policy scope
